correctness.rationale: For Cr_n, total domination is equivalent to selecting at least two vertices from each side. For an outside a_k, every defender lies on the B side; after one defender is removed, total domination survives exactly when at least two B vertices remain, giving |J|>=3 whenever I is not full. The symmetric condition handles outside B vertices. These necessary and sufficient conditions partition all secure total dominating sets and yield the polynomial by direct binomial counting. Exhaustive verification for 3<=n<=8 independently matches the definition, classification, polynomial coefficients, and minimum cases.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a natural complete classification and exact all-cardinality enumerator for a canonical highly symmetric graph family obtained by a minimal structured perturbation of K_{n,n}. It identifies precisely how one deleted 1-factor changes defender-swap feasibility, and shows a genuine jump from the complete-bipartite secure-total value to the crown value. The result therefore records structural information not captured by the scalar invariant alone.
